newsitem.title: UK: BRAZIL AGAIN DOMINANT IN NEW SUGAR FREIGHT ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL AGAIN DOMINANT IN NEW SUGAR FREIGHT ORDERS.

text.p: South Brazil provided most of the fresh inquiry as an origin on London's sugar freight market on Monday, shipbrokers said.
One order featuring on account lists was for 14,000 tonnes min/max bagged sugar from Santos to Algiers for August 25/30, they said.

Secretan appeared with two bulk Brazilian orders, quoting for 14,000 tonnes from north Brazil to Baltic or Black Sea for September 5/10 and a further 22,000 tonnes from Santos to Casablanca for August 25/30.
The latter order was with options of Mediterranean and Black Sea.
E D & F Man appeared again with more inquiry for Iran, quoting for 30,000 tonnes min/max bulk sugar from Paranagua for August 18/22.

David Bruce was open on account for 15,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from the Philippines to US west coast for prompt shipment and also for 10,000 tonnes in bags from Rio de Janeiro to Egypt/Aqaba for August 25/30.

Geepee quoted for 6/12,000 tonnes in bags from Bangkok to east coast India for prompt/onwards, while Mauritius Sugar Syndicate was open for 15,250/15,500 in bulk from Port Louis to London for August 18/25.
